doc: SPORE v1 core primitives, exposed over a C ABI (see src/ffi.rs).
note: Hand-maintained to mirror src/ffi.rs. Types: bytes = (ptr,len) slice; in8/in16/in32 = fixed input pointer; out8/out16/out32 = fixed output pointer; u32 = uint32. Returns: void | bytes (owned buffer) | bool.

functions.name: keypair
functions.doc: Generate an Ed25519 signing keypair (secret, public).

functions.name: prekey
functions.doc: Generate an X25519 encryption prekey pair (secret, public).

functions.name: seal
functions.doc: Anonymous sealed box to a recipient prekey.

functions.name: open
functions.doc: Open a sealed box with a prekey secret (None on failure).

functions.name: topic_seal
functions.doc: Encrypt for a topic under a 32-byte pre-shared key.

functions.name: topic_open
functions.doc: Decrypt a topic payload (None on failure).

functions.name: armor_unwrap
functions.doc: Recover envelope bytes from armor (None if absent).

functions.name: message_new
functions.doc: Build and sign a DATA envelope; returns wire bytes.

functions.name: message_id
functions.doc: Envelope 16-byte content ID (None if it doesn't decode).

functions.name: message_payload
functions.doc: Extract an envelope's payload (None if it doesn't decode).
